scope: One full autonomous ResearchService attempt per arm on identical frozen SQLite official snapshots. Neither reached publication. Not a fresh-web benchmark, stable speed estimate, or release acceptance.

strict_ci.scope: Windows/Python3.13 with MCP, not all platform/extras or clean wheel reinstall

verdicts.rollback: completed, with historical failed evidence and independent correctness fixes preserved
verdicts.read_delivery: demonstrated defect removed for this run: all candidate successful reads reached the next request as exact inline result content
verdicts.overall_efficiency: not accepted; both attempts paused unpublished and candidate total tokens increased despite fewer calls
verdicts.quality: not accepted as final reports; both have unpublished drafts with remaining evidence-strength or consistency problems

caveats: Fifteen-minute active evaluation window plus in-flight settlement is a diagnostic guard, not a production research budget or a measured time to successful completion.
One stochastic pair, baseline first; do not infer a stable speedup, win rate or pure causal allocation from role-path changes.
External invocation-to-settlement intervals include adapter/network behavior, not pure model inference; unions overlap between roles.
Legacy inline diagnostic receipts may overwrite observation_ref with result.ref. Exact result_hash verifies delivered content, not unique duplicate-observation identity.
Original ZIP hashes, artifact-manifest members, unique operation IDs, case/policy/evaluator equality and call counters were independently checked. Original failed jobs remain failed.

Full original public exports, fixture, four unpublished drafts and independent audit scripts are in the downloadable evidence bundle. This committed index is not the full native trace or private database.
